name: alwrity_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the alwrity capability.

prompts.name: content_strategy_generation
prompts.template: Create a digital marketing content strategy targeting {marketing_goals} with focus on {content_brief}.
prompts.use_case: Developing an AI-based content marketing plan for new product launches.

prompts.name: multimodal_content_creation
prompts.template: Generate {content_type} content based on the strategy: {content_strategy_plan}.
prompts.use_case: Automating creation and publishing of diverse marketing materials.

prompts.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompts.template: Analyze the content for SEO opportunities focusing on these keywords: {seo_keywords}.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing existing content for better search engine rankings using AI insights.

prompts.name: analytics_insight_request
prompts.template: Provide performance insights and recommendations for the campaign data: {performance_metrics}.
prompts.use_case: Managing multiple social media accounts and scheduling posts from one platform.

prompts.name: social_media_publish_schedule
prompts.template: Schedule publishing of content titled '{content_title}' across connected social media accounts on {publish_date}.
prompts.use_case: Tracking campaign performance and making data-driven marketing decisions.
